cohort: 51 primigravida pregnant women with PIH between 26-30 weeks gestation, experiencing at least three vascular symptoms, in a tertiary care hospital in a hilly area of Dehradun, Uttarakhand.
finding: PIH was associated with high rates of adverse perinatal outcomes including preterm labor (64.71%), c-section (76.47%), maternal complications (94.12%), low birth weight (90.38%), NICU admission (71.43%), neonatal resuscitation (42.86%), and neonatal complications (100%).
birth_weight: low birth weight (specific values not provided)
